plan.title: feat(vbrief): adapt to upstream xBRIEF v0.8 (vBRIEF renamed to xBRIEF; spec upgraded)
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5

narratives.Problem: Upstream renamed the plan-document spec (deftai/vBRIEF -> deftai/xBRIEF) and bumped it to v0.8: the info envelope key changed from vBRIEFInfo to xBRIEFInfo. Overdeck writes v0.6 documents and its readers reject the xBRIEFInfo envelope outright. Upstream's backlog contains a 'remove vbrief readpath' item, so the legacy envelope will eventually stop being readable by upstream tooling. Our fork eltmon/vBRIEF is 9 commits behind with 0 unique commits.
narratives.Proposal: Translate the envelope key at the read/write doors only, keeping the internal TypeScript field vBRIEFInfo unchanged (PRD D-1). Read door: a normalizeVBriefEnvelope helper applied at all seven raw-parse read sites accepts xBRIEFInfo and normalizes it to the internal field. Write door: a single serializeVBriefDocument function derives the on-disk key from the document version (>=0.7 -> xBRIEFInfo, <0.7 -> vBRIEFInfo; PRD D-2) and replaces JSON.stringify at exactly seven spec write sites. Writers (builder.ts, auto-synthesize.ts) and the two agent-facing prompt surfaces (planning template, write-vbrief skill; operator-approved D7) bump to version 0.8. The fork sync + rename (FR-7) was completed externally on 2026-07-07 (both masters at 56824ed4da99; CLAUDE.md links updated on main in 6240cf4a4f) - the plan carries only the remaining docs/VBRIEF.md reference updates. All code changes land in one PR (D-4).
narratives.NonGoals:
- Adopting PlanItem.type, PlanItem.summary, planRefs, status "auto" rollups, Source/Confidence narrative keys, or the x-xbrief/* extension registry (file follow-up issues if wanted)
- Changing pipeline call sites to emit failed instead of blocked (the enum already permits failed; semantics adoption is a separate behavioral change)
- Renaming .vbrief.json artifacts, docs/VBRIEF.md, the /write-vbrief skill name, or the vbrief/ viewer components (PRD D-5; requires a no-loss audit if ever done)
- Renaming the internal TypeScript field vBRIEFInfo or touching any frontend component (PRD D-1, NFR-1)
- Routing clone/byte-count/lock-file/tier-override JSON.stringify uses through the serializer (PRD D-6)
- Adding ajv (or any validator) as a package dependency

narrative.Action: Add exported serializeVBriefDocument(doc: { vBRIEFInfo: { version: string } }): string to src/lib/vbrief/io.ts (exact implementation in PRD WI-3 step 1: parseFloat the version; if finite and >= 0.7, destructure vBRIEFInfo out and JSON.stringify({ xBRIEFInfo: vBRIEFInfo, ...rest }, null, 2); else JSON.stringify(doc, null, 2).
